svg.title: Spin Hall drift-diffusion face fluxes, mixing-conductance interface, and volumetric FM spin reactions
svg.desc: Panel (a) shows spin-channel potential splitting V +/- mu_s/2 and the three finite-volume face flux terms Q_i. Panel (b) depicts the MixingConductanceSpinInterface separating longitudinal transmission and backflow from full transverse absorption. Panel (c) illustrates the triad of volumetric spin reactions R_sf, R_J, and R_phi inside the ferromagnet together with a computed spatial decay profile.
svg.text: Spin Hall Drift-Diffusion: Face Fluxes, Mixing-Conductance Interface, and FM Spin Reactions
Finite-volume steady balance ∂_i Q_ia + R_sf,a + R_J,a + R_ϕ,a = 0 with e > 0, conventional J_c, and angular-momentum current (ℏ / 2e) Q_ia
Spin-channel splitting V ± μ_s/2 and face flux Q_i
M1 uses charge face σ_f E_f from an accepted CurrentTransport snapshot (fv_spin_upwind_v1).
M2 reciprocal FDM couples (V, μ_s) using σ_s in both Pσ_s and θ_SHσ_s terms (iSHE + AMR/PHE/AHE).
Angular-momentum flux tensor: J^s_ia = (ℏ / 2e) Q_ia (first index i = flow, second index a = spin).
Zero transverse flux enters FM interface side
Tf,K​ = −(γe​/Ms​)(ℏ/2e)(A_f/V_K) qabs,⊥​ [area-to-volume conversion in cell K]
Volumetric spin reactions inside FM: ∂_i Q_ia + R_sf,a + R_J,a + R_ϕ,a = 0
R_sf relaxes all components; only R_J + R_ϕ torque m.
Dissipates spin to lattice; enters balance, not T_tr.
Always active (λ_sf > 0); anchors disconnected spin components without sinks.
Larmor precession of transverse spin around local m.
Negative sign transfers spin lost by conduction electrons into magnetization m.
FM spatial decay (1D reaction ODE, computed)
Depth into FM from HM/FM interface (nm)
